protectedSnapshot.questionText: The electrical power developed in the resistor shown above is
protectedSnapshot.explanation: Use P = V²/R for the 16 V supply and 2 Ω resistor. Therefore P = 16²/2 = 128 W.

protectedSnapshot.questionText: Assuming E₁, E₂ and E₃ are equal, the total e.m.f. of the arrangement shown is given by
protectedSnapshot.optionsJson: ["1/E = (1/E₁ + 1/E₂) + E₃","E = E₁ + E₂ + E₃","1/E = 1/E₁ + 1/E₂ + 1/E₃","E = E₁ = E₂ = E₃"]
protectedSnapshot.explanation: The identical cells are connected in parallel across common terminals. A parallel combination has the e.m.f. of one cell, so E = E₁ = E₂ = E₃.

protectedSnapshot.questionText: If a positively charged rod is brought close to the cap of the positively charged electroscope shown, the divergence of its leaves
protectedSnapshot.explanation: The positive rod repels positive charge further toward the leaves. Their like charges repel more strongly, so the divergence increases.

protectedSnapshot.questionText: The acceleration of the body shown in the liquid is
protectedSnapshot.explanation: The downward weight is 100 N, while upthrust and viscous drag total 25 N. Net force is 75 N, so a = 75/10 = 7.5 m/s².
